claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment
claims.evidence: The witness report confirms the presence of solar panels but cannot verify the seller's business specialization or inventory.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panels.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest possible wattage for panels of that physical size.

risks.risk: Damaged or missing junction boxes and cables
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear of the panels showing the junction boxes and MC4 connectors.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring significant repair or replacement of electrical components.

risks.proof: A video clip showing a multimeter reading of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.
A photo showing all panels in the stack spread out and visible for counting.
risks.if_unproven: as only the two clearly visible panels.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of a panel.
Photos of the back of the panels showing junction boxes and wiring.
A photo showing the total number of panels clearly.
A video of a multimeter test showing the current output.
response.reason: The power rating in Watts is the fundamental unit for pricing solar panels and is currently unknown. Without the specification label or a model number, even a worst-case valuation is not possible.
